item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry: July and August 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s July and August 2026 update adds stable Hosted Agent and Toolbox SDK paths, Claude tools support on Azure-hosted deployments, and Model Router updates. It also notes local inference improvements and SDK migration items to review before upgrading.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: dotnet: Announcing .NET 11 Release Candidate 1
item.description:
The .NET 11 Release Candidate 1 is now available. The release includes updates across libraries, runtime, SDK, MSBuild, NuGet, C#, F#, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, and Windows Forms.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Announcing v2.0 of the official MCP C# SDK
item.description:
The official MCP C# SDK v2.0 now implements the 2026-07-28 MCP specification. It adds a stateless-first protocol, standardized HTTP headers, and Multi Round-Trip Requests for interactive tools while remaining backward compatible.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: .NET 11 Preview 6 is now available!
item.description:
The post announces .NET 11 Preview 6 and says it includes updates across runtime, SDK, libraries, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, C#, Entity Framework Core, F#, and container images. No specific feature details are included in the provided text.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: Set AI credit session limits in Copilot CLI and SDK
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot SDK now support AI credit session limits, letting you cap how much an agent can spend in a single session. This is intended to help control usage during longer-running agent workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Client-side data integrity protections in Azure Blob Storage
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage now includes CRC64-NVME client-side data integrity protections in the latest Azure Blob SDKs for .NET, C++, and JavaScript. This builds on existing MD5 and server-side integrity validation support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Analysis depth and efficiency updates
item.description:
Copilot code review now uses built-in file exploration tools from the Copilot CLI and SDK. GitHub says this improves review cost efficiency without changing the existing workflow.

  • Source: GitHub
